example.title: Mac's Super Service Station, Traverse City
example.place: Traverse City, Grand Traverse County, MI

brief: A small streamline service station: pale green enamel-panelled walls with rounded corners, a flat roof, two service bays and an office with a stepped tower, fuel pumps in front. One photo. Older than 1970: a pre-war main-street building; no newer example of this type on the lake. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
